Passport Information
Passport Application
You must apply in person in the Register of Deeds’ office for a passport. Current driver’s license or other photo ID must be presented at time of application. A certified birth certificate and 2 passport photos must be sent with application. The birth certificate will be returned with your passport. Children under the age of 16 must have both parents present for signatures on the application. It takes 10-13 weeks for the application to be processed and the passport is valid for 10 years. Passports for children under the age of 16 are valid for 5 years.
Applications may be obtained from the US Department of State’s Web Site – https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/passports/how-apply/forms.html (Department of State forms are PDF – Reader Application Required)
Appointments can be made by visiting:
https://shiawassee.setmore.com/bookappointment
Schedule A Passport Appointment
Passport Processing Times:
Monday – Friday 8:00 A.M. – 11:00 A.M. & 1:00 P.M. – 4:00 P.M.
New U.S. Passport Book
REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION
o Proof of citizenship (original or certified copy of birth certificate, naturalization papers, etc.)
o Photo identification (driver’s license, state-issued ID card)
o If a minor child, must provide birth certificate
o Passport photo that meets the passport State Department Passport Photo Requirements. U.S. Passport Photos (state.gov)
**WE OFFER PASSPORT PHOTOS for $16.00**
APPLICATIONS
NEW PASSPORT APPLICATION, APPLICATION FOR A U.S. PASSPORT
RENEWAL PASSPORT APPLICATION U.S. PASSPORT RENEWAL APPLICATION
FEES
Applicants 16 Years of Age or Older:
o $130 check or money order payable to the “U.S. Department of State.”
o $35 cash, check or money order payable to “Shiawassee County Register of Deeds.”
Applicants 15 Years of Age or Younger:
o $100 check or money order payable to the “U.S. Department of State.”
o $35 cash, check or money order payable to “Shiawassee County Register of Deeds
New Passport Card
What is a Passport Card?
These cards will carry the rights and privileges of the U.S. passport book and will be adjudicated to the exact same standards.
Passport cards can be used for travel to and from Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean and Bermuda by land or sea. The passport card cannot be used for international travel by air.
Expiration Dates
Cards will be valid for 10 years for adults and 5 years for children 15 years of age or younger.
New Applications
Applicant 16 Years of Age or Older
o $30 check or money order payable to “U.S. Department of State.”
o $35 cash, check or money order payable to “Shiawassee County Register of Deeds.”
Applicants 15 years of Age or Younger
o $15 check or money order payable to “U.S. Department of State.”
o $35 cash, check or money order payable to “Shiawassee County Register of Deeds.”
For More Information
For further information, please visit the U.S. Passports and International Travel website
